blocks.section: Perform parallel alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: NOTICE: The specified permitted reading values are valid only at operating temperature. For cold settings, other values are permitted. You must use the correct tolerances. Failure to do so can result in misalignment and reduced pump reliability.

blocks.content: Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: A unit is in complete alignment when both the angular indicator (A) and the parallel indicator (P) do not vary by more than 0.002 in. (0.05 mm) as measured at four points 90° apart.

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Set the angular and parallel dial indicators to zero at the top-center position (12 o'clock) of  the driver coupling half  (Y).

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Rotate the indicators to the bottom-center position (6 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction
Perform complete alignment for a vertical correction
blocks.content: Make corrections according to the separate instructions for angular and parallel alignment until you obtain the permitted reading values.

blocks.content: Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: A unit is in complete alignment when both the angular indicator (A) and the parallel indicator (P) do not vary by more than 0.002 in. (0.05 mm) as measured at four points 90° apart.

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Set the angular and parallel dial indicators to zero at the left side of  the driver coupling half  (Y), 90° from the top-center position (9 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Rotate the indicators through the top-center position to the right side, 180° from the start position (3 o'clock).

blocks.section: Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction
Perform complete alignment for a horizontal correction
blocks.content: Make corrections according to the separate instructions for angular and parallel alignment until you obtain the permitted reading values.
Intended use The C-face adapter is a device that attaches the pump to the drive unit to minimize the axial and radial play between the two coupling halves.
